derivedHigherTierDegradation.rule: A tier rejected between the lowest and highest accepted tier on either oracle axis is degraded.
derivedHigherTierDegradation.interpretation: The fields are derived from the two tier sets, not entered independently by the annotator. This prevents a stale checkbox from reporting zero non-monotonicity. The denominator is the sampled 32-page oracle, not the corpus.

axisDivergenceContext.interpretation: T2 preserved recoverable block structure while Thai character fragmentation made the text reading-insufficient. The independent axes may legally diverge.

pages.note: The page carries essentially no substantive text.

nearEmptyAcceptanceContext.interpretation: Criterion B measures material loss relative to visible page content, not an absolute output-length floor; sparse pages can therefore have valid near-empty outputs.
